title: Vedic Speed Multiplication & Mental Deviation Engines

concept.heading: The Base Deviation Shortcut ($(B + d_1)(B + d_2)$)
concept.subText: Multiply two numbers close to reference bases in 2 seconds without paper calculations.
concept.voiceover: Welcome to Day 2, Part 1. When multiplying numbers close to 100, calculate their deviations from base 100. Add crosswise for the left digits, and multiply the deviations for the right digits.

workedExample.question: Evaluate the exact product: $93 \times 97$ without using standard long multiplication.
workedExample.voiceover: Look at 93 times 97. 93 is minus 7, 97 is minus 3. Crosswise 93 minus 3 gives 90. Multiply minus 7 by minus 3 to get 21. Combine to get 9021 in two seconds.

practiceDrill.question: What is the exact product of $106 \times 109$?
practiceDrill.voiceover: Now test your speed! 106 times 109. You have 10 seconds!

concept.heading: Universal 2-Digit & 3-Digit Criss-Cross
concept.subText: Single-line multiplication for arbitrary numbers without partial products.

cards.title: 🔄 3-Step Pattern
cards.content: 1. Vertical Right (b×d) ➔ 2. Cross Sum (ad + bc) ➔ 3. Vertical Left (a×c)

cards.title: ⚡ Speed Advantage
cards.content: Zero scratchpad lines required. Perfect for PSU CBT timer pressure.

concept.voiceover: In Part 2, we use Urdhva Tiryagbhyam. Vertical right, cross add, vertical left. Every two digit product is completed in a single line.

workedExample.examTag: SSC CGL TIER-1 / RRB JE PYQ
workedExample.question: Multiply $73 \times 46$ in a single horizontal line.
workedExample.voiceover: Step 1: 3 times 6 is 18, write 8 carry 1. Step 2: 7 times 6 is 42, 3 times 4 is 12, plus carry 1 is 55, write 5 carry 5. Step 3: 7 times 4 is 28, plus 5 is 33. Result is 3358.

practiceDrill.question: Calculate $64 \times 37$ using the single-line criss-cross method:
practiceDrill.voiceover: Drill number two! Calculate 64 times 37 in 10 seconds.

parts.title: Digital Root & Casting Out Nines Elimination Engine

concept.heading: The Modulo-9 Digital Root Filter
concept.subText: Verify calculations and eliminate 3 out of 4 options in complex algebra and arithmetic in 3 seconds.
concept.formulaLatex: \text{Digital Root } D(N) = N \pmod 9 \quad (\text{treat } 9 \text{ and } 0 \text{ as identical})

cards.title: 💡 Property
cards.content: D(A × B) = D( D(A) × D(B) ) | D(A + B) = D( D(A) + D(B) )

cards.title: 🎯 Instant Filter
cards.content: If an option's digital root does not match, it is mathematically 100% false.

concept.voiceover: Part 3 gives you the ultimate exam superpower: Casting Out Nines. The digital root of the product must equal the product of the digital roots.

workedExample.question:
Which option is equal to $342 \times 516$?
A) 176,462   B) 176,472   C) 176,482   D) 176,492
workedExample.voiceover: 342 has digit sum 9 which is 0 modulo 9. Anything times 0 is 0 modulo 9. Check the options: only Option B has digit sum 9. Solved in 4 seconds without calculating.

practiceDrill.question:
Find the correct value of $213 \times 421$ using digital roots:
A) 89,673   B) 89,573   C) 89,773   D) 89,873
practiceDrill.voiceover: Final drill! Find 213 times 421 using digital roots. 10 seconds!
